description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for decoding HEIF images, including enums for color formats and color spaces, a frame info struct, stream and decoder interfaces, and a factory function for creating decoders.

classes.name: HeifFrameInfo
classes.description: Represents a color-converted (RGB-based) video frame with metadata such as dimensions, rotation, duration, bit depth, and ICC data.

classes.name: HeifStream
classes.description: Abstract interface for providing data to the HEIF decoder, including methods for reading, seeking, rewinding, and length reporting.

classes.name: HeifDecoder
classes.description: Abstract interface for decoding HEIF images from a data source, with methods for initialization, configuration, decoding, and retrieving scanlines.

methods.name: createHeifDecoder
methods.description: Factory function to create an instance of a HEIF decoder.
